import math

def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    S = 85
    K = 90
    r = 0.05
    c = 10
    p = 15
    T = 5

    # Put-call parity: c - p = S*exp(-q*T) - K*exp(-r*T)
    discounted_stock = c - p + K * math.exp(-r * T)
    q = -math.log(discounted_stock / S) / T
    answer = round(q * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
